sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Pawan Kumar Shukla,Rajesh Kumar Gautam Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
Matter is taken up in the revised call.
By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.292 of 2023 at Police Station-Didarganj, District-Azamgarh under Sections 302, 376 IPC.
The applicant is in jail since 11.11.2023.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 23.01.2024.

The following arguments made by Shri Pawan Kumar Shukla, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA-I from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
Pradeep vs State Of U.P. on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/133600269/
1
1. This is a case of honour killing.
2. The applicant and the deceased were intimate.
They were caught in a compromising position.
The applicant had made good his escape, but the deceased was upbraided very severely by her family members.
3. The deceased was a sensitive person who became depressed on account of the regular harassment from her family members.
4. On the fateful day, the deceased succumbed to depression and took the extreme step of ending her life.
She committed suicide by hanging.
5. The post mortem report opines that the cause of death is asphyxia due to antemortem hanging.

6. Injuries depicted in the post mortem report consistent with hanging are:
(i). Nature of ligature mark.
(ii).
The hyoid bone was intact.
7. The applicant did not aid or abet the suicide.
8. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from the instant case.
9. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to join the trial proceedings.
There is no possibility of her influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant-Pradeep be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
( ii )
The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

The learned trial court is directed to fix the sureties after due application of mind in light of the judgement rendered by this Court in Arvind Singh v. State of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt.
Pradeep vs State Of U.P. on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/133600269/
2 (Application U/S 482 No.2613 of 2023).
The learned trial court shall ensure that the right of bail of the applicant granted by this Court is not frustrated by arbitrary demands of sureties or onerous conditions which are unrelated to the socioeconomic status of the applicant.
Order Date :- 13.8.2024
